question: Show the ids and names of the countries that make more than three cars or produce Fiat vehicles.
gold_query: SELECT T1.countryId , T1.CountryName FROM Countries AS T1 JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T2 ON T1.CountryId = T2.Country GROUP BY T1.countryId HAVING count(*) > 3 UNION SELECT T1.countryId , T1.CountryName FROM Countries AS T1 JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T2 ON T1.CountryId = T2.Country JOIN MODEL_LIST AS T3 ON T2.Id = T3.Maker WHERE T3.Model = 'fiat'

steps.raw_response: {"sql": "SELECT countries.CountryId, countries.CountryName FROM countries JOIN car_makers ON car_makers.Country = countries.CountryId LEFT JOIN model_list ON model_list.Maker = car_makers.Id GROUP BY countries.CountryId, countries.CountryName HAVING COUNT(model_list.ModelId) > 3 OR MAX(car_makers.Maker = 'fiat') = 1"}
